comments: 34e0ba1f: This section of code is responsible for handling the input and processing of deficiency records in the IRT system.
0b763658: Prompt user to enter the event date; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
fe03e338: Check if event date is before admission date, if so, reset to admission date and inform user.
78b821e5: Ensure event date is not after the discharge date, if so, reset to discharge date and inform user.
ead107c3: If the deficiency type is '1', set the last admission date.
85487272: For non-type '1', set event date with default time if no time is provided.
d6d39761: Invoke patient inquiry if source is IRT.
369012d1: Clear DIR prompt variables and set default ward if available.
124d1aae: Prompt for ward location; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
1f8ed0bb: Set default treating specialty if available.
691d3c2c: Prompt for treating specialty; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
46af48b4: Set service connected condition based on ward location if not associated with a hospital location.
c8a04fe1: Set service connected condition based on hospital location if ward is associated.
3decbf57: Determine default service connection and prompt user; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
21963b56: Prompt for service connection; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
bf5fefe1: Set default physician based on discharge movement, if applicable.
14d29e65: Prompt for primary physician; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
6c106492: Set default provider to 'A' if deficiency is not signed and is active.
23acfc79: Set default provider to attending physician if deficiency is signed.
cfbec43a: Prompt for secondary physician based on deficiency status; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
3c46fcbb: Set default primary reviewer based on primary physician.
1d0bb145: Prompt for primary reviewer; exit if input is '^', or on timeout.
edeb1c53: Initialize file entry for a new deficiency record.
8577e6e9: Set the edit template for entering deficiency details.
29f8b887: Use the IRT deficiency entry form for non-summary types.
713d597d: Use the IRT record entry form for summary types.
f785271e: Execute the input template processing.
df2be85d: Reinitialize the list screen after processing.
816e5987: Handle exit action, refreshing the list view.
66add81f: Terminate processing of this routine.
c3f10d43: Count the number of deficiencies without a status for the patient.
8876ba2a: Exit the SCR subroutine.
9119c20c: Increment deficiency count if matching division and without deletion flag.
f093d4cf: Setup the global for displaying deficiencies.
b605bc69: Exit the SCR1 subroutine.
d6c0cc00: Check if the division of the deficiency matches the user's division.
a81d52e4: Retrieve the default deficiency resolution status based on division.
2cf39d19: Set the default status based on whether the deficiency is signed.
d8cc876f: Retrieve discharge or admission related information to assist in document processing.
725cda82: Retrieve the name of the physician for display.
10fdb7df: Determine the appropriate provider based on the deficiency status.
1cf32ae5: Set the provider based on admission, attending, or no provider.
8e732584: Exit the DOC1 subroutine.
19a342c0: Set the admission type description for display.
95ad7143: Exit the DT1 subroutine.
473ddab2: Initialize temporary storage for report processing.
b13fdd39: Clear the temporary global used for report generation.
632d51ba: Initialize variables for report line counting.
91b9af7e: Prepare the initial line setup for the deficiency report.
b9aef9eb: Set message indicating no deficiency was created.
2425b06f: Call to generate the deficiency report view.
0b1ee403: Exit the TMP subroutine.
2205d350: Process direct jump to a category based on user selection.
d45f2061: Prompt user to select a deficiency category for navigation.
e41e40f4: Handle exit from category selection.
3c42f4bb: Retry category selection if the first attempt fails.
bab6efc9: Initialize variable for selected category.
cffd169e: Store the category selected by the user.
f92e0d09: Display message if the selected category contains no deficiencies.
0f98b718: Set the starting line number for display based on selected category.
45ffd56e: Exit the JUMP subroutine.
